name: Weaviate
summary: Open-source AI-native vector database with a managed cloud, a free-forever cluster, and a pay-as-you-go Flex plan.
description: Open-source AI-native vector database with a managed cloud, a free-forever cluster, and a pay-as-you-go Flex plan.

pricing.details: Free Forever 0 €/month, no credit card — 1 cluster per user, 100,000 objects, 1 GB memory, 10 GB disk, 1 collection and up to 3 tenants, embeddings (2,000 requests/day) and Query Agent (1,000 requests/month), basic support. Flex starts at 41 €/month, pay-as-you-go, no commitment — shared cloud cluster, core DB toolkit and replication, RBAC, 99.5% uptime, Query Agent free tier plus usage-based embeddings, standard support. Premium (dedicated or shared, prepaid contract) is contact sales and has no public starting price.
pricing.label: Freemium
